message: Build a beautiful static index.html trail guide for four fictional local walks. Each card needs distance, difficulty, duration and a short description. Filter by difficulty, with all as default and an empty state. Explain that routes are fictional. Use inline CSS/vanilla JS and CSS illustrations, responsive layouts and accessible controls, no network assets.

profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
